description: This PHP class 'MaxMindGeoLite2Downloader' handles downloading, decompressing, and updating MaxMind GeoLite2 City database files, including file locking and network requests.

classes.name: MaxMindGeoLite2Downloader
classes.description: A class for managing the download and update of MaxMind GeoLite2 City database files, including file locking, network requests, and decompression.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the downloader with a Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up temporary files upon object destruction.

methods.name: updateGeoLiteDatabase
methods.description: Main method to update the GeoLite database if needed, with locking.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Creates a lock file to prevent concurrent updates.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock and deletes the lock file.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads data as a string from a given suffix.

methods.name: downloadTo
methods.description: Downloads data directly to a specified file.

methods.name: clientGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request with authentication and query parameters.

methods.name: decompress
methods.description: Decompresses a .tar.gz file and extracts the .mmdb file.

methods.name: getFullPath
methods.description: Returns the full path for storage based on MAX_PATH.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs the update process: download MD5, compare, download archive, decompress, and save MD5.
